creator_concentration.rule: No account may contribute more than 1% of content items to an aggregate analytical cohort. Account-census rows remain one row per deduplicated native account.
creator_concentration.case_study_exception: A separately labeled case-study stratum is excluded from aggregate estimates and does not relax the main-cohort cap.

non_claims: Approval does not prove platform access or quota.
The 10-12K target is not complete until qualified, deduplicated, evidence-linked account rows pass review.
Unavailable interactions remain null and are not inferred.
